name: Survival
description: Kaplan-Meier survival curves and the log-rank test, computed in Java over at most 100000 rows. Mode km emits one row per distinct event time with time, n_at_risk, events, censored, survival and the Greenwood log confidence interval ci_low/ci_high (clamped to [0, 1]; the maximal [0, 1] when the last observation is an event), plus the optional group column. Mode logrank emits one row with test, statistic, df, p_value and groups: the Mantel-Haenszel (O-E)'V^-1(O-E) over the first k-1 groups with the hypergeometric variance and a chi-square p-value with k-1 degrees of freedom. The time column is numeric or a date; event is boolean or 0/1 numeric; rows with a NULL time, event or group are dropped.

time.title: Time column
time.description: Numeric or date column with the non-negative follow-up time.

event.title: Event column
event.description: Boolean or numeric 0/1 column: 1/true is an event, 0/false a censoring.

group.title: Group column
group.description: Optional categorical column: one curve per group; required for mode logrank (at least two groups).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: km emits the Kaplan-Meier curve; logrank runs the log-rank test over the groups.
